verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a passing mention that Bitbucket lets you set granular package permissions, including for container images and tags. That implies some package or container hosting exists, but nothing shows publish and consume workflows or support for more than one format. Missing for 10: documented publish/consume workflows, evidence of multiple package formats (e.g. npm, Maven, PyPI) beyond container images, dedicated registry documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
